description: This Kotlin source file defines a class 'ProfileBottomSheetDialog' which creates a bottom sheet dialog in an Android app to show user profile actions such as email, profile, and talk options. It handles UI setup, user interactions, and intent launching for actions like opening websites, sending emails, and starting a talk activity.

classes.name: ProfileBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: A bottom sheet dialog class that displays user profile actions such as email, profile, and talk options, and handles user interactions to perform these actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, inflates the layout, sets up UI elements, and populates actions based on the hoverCard data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Dispatches actions based on the appId, such as opening a website, sending an email, or opening a talk activity.

methods.name: openWebsite
methods.description: Opens a URL in the browser using DisplayUtils.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Creates and starts an email intent to send an email to the specified address.

methods.name: openTalk
methods.description: Intended to start a talk activity; currently contains a placeholder for implementation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the dialog is stopped.
